commands.name: adr
commands.title: Architecture Decision Records
commands.description: Create, update, or review an Architecture Decision Record (ADR)
commands.default_action: creating or reviewing an Architecture Decision Record
instructions:
Enforce the 5 Core Tenets:
   - **Intent over Mechanism:** Domain capability and architectural invariants over tool brand names.
   - **Reification over Tribal Memory:** Mechanically enforceable via explicit types, module boundaries, automated CI fitness functions (e.g., ArchUnit, import linter rules), contract tests, or alarms.
   - **Honest Trade-offs & Real Alternatives:** Zero free lunches; evaluate genuine runners-up and state why they were rejected.
   - **Advice Process over Gatekeepers:** Autonomous team ownership with transparent alignment (`Consulted` and `Informed`).
   - **Reversibility & Immutability:** Two-way doors with explicit revisit criteria; immutable accepted history.
Structure the record using the 8-row Tabular Y-Statement, prioritized Decision Drivers (`DRV-01`, `DRV-02`, etc.), and the Multi-Criteria Comparison Matrix.
Pass the Uninformed Reader Test (understandable in 3 minutes) and guard against the 6 Anti-Patterns.
Fulfill the user's specific request: drafting a new ADR or reviewing an existing one.

commands.name: review
commands.title: Bart Adversarial Code Reviewer
commands.description: Critically review code, diffs, or pull requests for bugs, edge cases, and design flaws
commands.default_action: critically reviewing code or a pull request
instructions: Perform an adversarial code review looking for bugs, edge cases, correctness failures, lazy shortcuts, and pattern violations.
Check whether the target repository defines its own review agent via find-repo-agents.sh.
Scrutinize tests, verify real failure modes, and evaluate CI results before providing a clear quality assessment and merge decision.

commands.name: humanize
commands.title: AI Text Humanizer
commands.description: Review and remove signs of AI-generated writing from text, ADRs, or docs
instructions: Scan for AI-isms, inflated vocabulary, formulaic structure, and promotional filler documented in references/patterns.md.
Rewrite problematic sections with natural, direct language while preserving core meaning and voice.
Conduct a final anti-AI critique pass to ensure the text sounds authentically human.

commands.name: c4
commands.title: C4 Architecture Diagrams
commands.description: Generate software architecture documentation using C4 model Mermaid diagrams
instructions: Determine the appropriate C4 abstraction level (C4Context, C4Container, C4Component, C4Deployment) based on the audience.
Analyze the codebase structure and dependencies to accurately map containers, components, and relationships.
Generate valid Mermaid C4 diagrams with explanatory architectural notes.

commands.name: commit
commands.title: Atomic Commit Protocol
commands.description: Structure and format git commits following the Atomic Commit Protocol (ACP)
commands.default_action: formatting and staging an atomic commit
instructions: Enforce the Atomic Commit Protocol (ACP): every commit must be a self-contained, tested, indivisible unit of work.
Verify that implementation and tests are together, tests pass, and code quality checks are satisfied.
Format commit messages strictly adhering to Conventional Commits format (`type(scope): subject`).

commands.name: standup
commands.title: Daily Standup Planner
commands.description: Turn meeting transcripts into actionable daily plans, decisions, and issue updates
instructions: Extract key updates, blockers, decisions, and action items from the meeting transcript or discussion.
Correlate updates with open GitHub issues, project items, or tracking boards.
Generate a clear, sequenced execution plan for the day with assigned ownership.

commands.name: status
commands.title: Daily Status Reporter
commands.description: Generate a factual summary of recent git commits, PRs, and assigned issues
instructions: Gather activity strictly from git logs, GitHub PRs/issues, and project tracking systems.
Prioritize factual recall over speculation: every line must correspond to verified system output.
Format the report into a dated summary suitable for logging to ~/projects/dailies/.

commands.name: bdd
commands.title: Adzic BDD Specification
commands.description: Apply Gojko Adzic Specification by Example principles to feature files and user stories
commands.default_action: refining BDD specifications and feature files
instructions: Apply Gojko Adzic's Specification by Example principles to Gherkin feature files.
Evaluate and optimize scenarios using the Adzic Index.
Ensure business-readable acceptance criteria focused on behavior rather than UI interactions.
